Esta práctica se encuentra en toda la Biblia, desde el tiempo de Moisés con la lectura de la Ley hasta las reformas del rey Josías y la renovación que trajo al pueblo de Israel un líder como Esdras.
En la época de Jesús, leer la Ley y los Profetas en voz alta en las sinagogas era un elemento central de la vida judía. Discutir los pasajes de la Biblia al terminar la lectura, es completamente opcional pero te recomendamos que sea simplemente para compartir lo que más les gustó de la lectura; este no es un tiempo para predicar o enseñar, sino para escuchar juntos la Palabra de Dios. Practical app to the Devotion of the Divine Mercy. This app allows you to pray the Novena, Chaplet and Rosary daily and record your progress to help you easily continue the next day. Save your own prayers by adding a photo to make it easier for you to make your requests every day.

Functions:

- Programmable reminders to encourage the habit of praying daily.
- The app saves your progress.
- List of your Requests.
- Audio Player.

Novena to the Divine Mercy  is a Catholic novena composed by Faustina Kowalska in her diary Divine Mercy in my Soul as part of the Divine Mercy devotion. Each day of the novena consists of praying to God the Father and Jesus for a different group of people - in particular, Catholics - by immersing them in the Sacred Heart. According to Faustina, Jesus told her that she will pray the Divine Mercy novena in heaven and that he will bring the people she prays for into heaven. He also told her that, because she would beg for his divine grace for the people in light of his Passion, he would not deny granting the people any of his grace.
